scope: Queue native ownership after STOP acknowledgement
finding: Earlier reverse acknowledgement remained true after queue STOP, so a later native BACK with unchanged destinations could be treated as the old issued reverse and stopped/handed back over.
implementation: Sticky queueStopAcknowledged records actual native STOP input. Queue observation, active destination-control ownership and recovery release no longer accept BACK or the original pre-issue input after that acknowledgement. Replacement commands retire metadata without replaying old native control.

validation.fullPipeline: 1477 existing tests and sequential compiler/FSM/config/docs/parity/performance/package gates passed

limits: This is an observable STOP-to-BACK transition, not a solution for identical directives while the original BACK is still active.
No new build credit or performance claim.
